violation_type.title: Requirements for Stacking Wall Cribs - Doors Securely Fastened (26 TAC §746.2413(4))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Stacking Wall Cribs - Doors Securely Fastened
violation_type.typical_finding: An infant was observed in the crib with the drop gate not secured.    Note: The gate was secured by the director.
